parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/MP3StreamerTests/CPUSessionAggregatorTests.swift`. The two test methods — `contextTransitionStartsNewSession` (line 186) and `sameContextTransitionDoesNothing` (line 265) — are structurally similar (Jaccard 0.727) because they exercise related but intentionally distinct behaviours of `CPUSessionAggregator`: one asserts that a context transition opens a new session, the other asserts that a same-context transition is a no-op.
